summary: Lord Abbett Private Credit Fund S filed an 8-K covering Items 3.02 (unregistered sales of equity securities), 7.01 (Regulation FD portfolio disclosure), and 8.01 (other events). The Company issued ~263,173 common shares at $24.71/share for ~$6.5 million aggregate proceeds to accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. This is a routine capital raise for a non-traded BDC, not a special situation. Portfolio metrics as of June 30, 2026 show $531M in loan commitments, 94% senior secured debt, and a 9.3% weighted average yield. No extraordinary event, merger, tender, activist campaign, restructuring, spin-off, or other special-situations catalyst is present.
